messages:
hana: quick game for the slack night owls — 'flip a track, sell a book' challenge. pick a song and write a one-line book pitch that pairs with it. go! :sparkles:
sam: starting — "Hard Rain" by Bob Dylan. Book pitch: 'A washed-up reporter chases one myth after another until the truth drowns him.' :newspaper:
jess: song: Fleetwood Mac - "Everywhere". pitch: 'Two neighbors trade lives for a week and learn how much of their grief was really habit.' :house:
omar: putting this banger: "Daft Punk - Something About Us". pitch: 'An AI learns romance by reading old fanfiction and nearly ruins three lives.' :robot_face: :broken_heart:
liam: song: "Daft Punk - One More Time" (feel free to judge me). pitch: 'A band reunites for charity, discovers a decades-old letter that rewrites their origin story.' :guitar:
noah: gloomy pick: Radiohead - "Where I End and You Begin". pitch: 'Two estranged siblings inherit a lighthouse and the secrets inside the cellar.' :lighthouse:
jess: tiny add — if you want to include a 1-line reading mood instead of pitch, cool too. I'm mixing both formats. :ok_hand:
hana: love these. rule: can include a 1-line mood, a micro-blurb, or a gif link. no long synopses. :thumbsup:
sam: mood version: song: "Run the Jewels - Legend Has It". mood: 'brash, midnight highway, reckless decisions.' :dash:
omar: gif link to sell it: https://giphy.com/gifs/woah-nice-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (use for courtroom drama pitches)
liam: book pitch+code snippet fwiw:
```txt
Song: Nina Simone - "Feeling Good"
Pitch: 'An ex-con teaches music therapy; each lesson peels back a town's lies.'
```
jess: vote: who should narrate the anthology version of all these? I nominate @noah for voice acting. :raised_hands:
noah: I'll narrate but only if I get a dramatic, foggy audio filter and an apple on my desk. :apple: :microphone:
hana: dev-bot, note: add "flip-a-track" to the #random weekly threads list? :robot_face:
dev-bot: echoed to #random-archive — thread archived with tags [music, books, micro-challenge]. :page_facing_up: :robot_face:
sam: favorite so far: Omar's AI-fanfiction one. instant audiobook. :headphones:
liam: whoa same. also adding these to my weekend queue. thanks y'all. :coffee:
jess: quick poll — should we do a 'flip-a-track' slack thread every Friday? :ballot_box: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
hana: yes pls. makes the end of week feel curated. :sparkles:
noah: agreed. will DM anyone who wants to collab on a short-read anthology crossover. :mailbox_with_mail:
omar: tagging a reading party next month. bring snacks. :chips: :popcorn:
hana: okay closing thread — love the energy. leave a 👏 on your favs and I'll try to stitch a tiny zine out of the top five. :clap:
